text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. Start by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and creating a realistic schedule. Decide which tasks are most important and do them first, so urgent work never catches you by surprise. Scope management is also essential: if a project grows too big, discuss it early instead of silently struggling. Finally, communicate openly with your team or teacher. If you see a problem, say so before the deadline, not after. People respect honesty and can often help you find a solution. With planning, focus and clear communication, deadlines become much easier to handle.
